name: Coconut rice pudding with mango
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water, then drain it.
Pour the coconut milk and water into a saucepan, add the rice and cook over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla.
Purée the mango until smooth and spoon it over the warm pudding.
Serve warm. Before 9 months, blend everything for a perfectly smooth texture.

name: Apple and date cinnamon sauce
steps: Peel the apples, core them and cut into cubes.
Finely chop the dates.
Put the apples, dates and water in a saucepan, cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
Add the cinnamon and lemon juice, then purée until very smooth.
Serve warm or cold. Before 9 months, pass the sauce through a sieve.

name: Lentil, squash and carrot purée
steps: Cut the butternut squash and the carrot into cubes.
Pour the broth into a saucepan, add the squash and carrot, then simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the lentils and olive oil, then continue for 5 minutes.
Purée until smooth using the cooking liquid.
Adjust the texture to the child's age: smooth at 6 months, mashed around 9 months.

name: Chicken, sweet potato and green peas
steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into cubes.
Pour the broth into a saucepan, add the chicken pieces and the sweet potato, then cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
Add the peas and continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Check that the chicken is cooked through, then add the canola oil.
Purée or mash with a fork, depending on the child's age.

name: Roasted sweet potato sticks
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Peel the sweet potato and cut it into thick sticks, about the width of an adult finger.
Coat with olive oil and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake for 25 minutes, until a stick crushes between two fingers.
Let cool slightly before serving. A stick should give under light pressure.

name: Soft banana oat patties
steps: Mash the banana with a fork.
Mix the rolled oats, banana, applesauce and cinnamon.
Let rest for 5 minutes so the oats absorb the moisture.
Shape into flat patties and brown them in canola oil in a pan, 3 minutes per side.
Let cool slightly. Cut into strips for a child aged 6 to 8 months.

name: Creamy mango oatmeal
steps: Bring the oat beverage to a simmer in a saucepan.
Add the rolled oats and chia seeds, then cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Purée the mango and stir it in off the heat with the cinnamon.
Let cool slightly — the oatmeal thickens as it cools.
Blend before 9 months for a smooth texture.

name: Tender rice flour crêpes
steps: Mix the ground flaxseed with 60 ml of oat beverage and let rest for 5 minutes.
Whisk the rice flour, the remaining oat beverage and the applesauce.
Stir in the flax mixture until the batter is smooth.
Cook in a pan with canola oil, 2 minutes per side.
Serve in finger-width strips.

name: Salmon and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Peel Sweet potato, cut into chunks, and steam 10 minutes until fork-tender.
Mash Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth; let cool 5 minutes.
Flake cooked Salmon (skin removed) into the bowl with the mashed Sweet potato.
Thinly slice Green onion and chop Fresh dill; add both to the bowl.
Add Egg, Breadcrumbs, and Lemon juice; mix until a firm mixture forms.
Shape mixture into 12 patties about 1.5 cm thick; place on the prepared sheet.
Brush patties lightly with Canola oil on both sides.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once at 10 minutes, until golden and firm.
Serve with Plain yogurt for dipping. Keeps refrigerated 2 days; freeze up to 1 month.

name: Oat and Banana Energy Bites
steps: Peel and mash 2 Bananas in a large bowl until smooth.
Add Natural peanut butter and Maple syrup to the bowl.
Stir in Cinnamon and Chia seeds until evenly combined.
Add Rolled oats and Raisins; stir to form a thick dough.
Refrigerate the dough for 10 minutes until firm enough to roll.
Roll the dough into 18 balls of about 3 cm each.
Arrange balls on a parchment-lined plate in a single layer.
Serve immediately or refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

name: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube Sweet potato; microwave 5 minutes until fork-tender.
Mash Sweet potato and Cooked chickpeas together in a large bowl.
Add Egg, Chickpea flour, Ground cumin, Sweet paprika, and Salt.
Mix until a firm dough forms that holds its shape.
Divide into 10 patties about 1.5 cm thick; place on the lined sheet.
Brush each patty lightly with Olive oil on both sides.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and firm.
Cool 5 minutes before serving; store in the fridge up to 3 days.

name: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube sweet potato, then steam until fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
Mash sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth and lump-free.
Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas, then add to the bowl.
Mash chickpeas roughly, leaving some texture.
Add egg, chickpea flour, cumin, turmeric, and salt; stir until combined.
Roll mixture into 18 balls and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush each bite lightly with olive oil.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.

name: Banana, Oat and Blueberry Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk mashed banana, eggs, plain yogurt, canola oil, maple syrup, and vanilla in a large bowl.
Add oat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and cinnamon to the bowl.
Stir until just combined; do not overmix.
Fold in blueberries gently with a spatula.
Divide batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature up to 2 days, or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato and Broccoli
steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube Sweet potato into 2 cm pieces; cut Broccoli into small florets.
Mince Garlic and whisk together with Olive oil, Lemon juice, Paprika, and Salt in a small bowl.
Toss Sweet potato cubes with half the olive oil mixture; spread on one side of the baking sheet.
Roast Sweet potato 15 minutes until beginning to soften.
Add Broccoli and Salmon portions to the baking sheet; drizzle remaining olive oil mixture over all.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes until Salmon flakes easily and Sweet potato is golden and tender.
Sprinkle Fresh dill over everything before serving. Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

name: Sweet Potato & Oat Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube Sweet potato, then steam for 12 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the cooked Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth.
Add the Egg and Canola oil to the bowl and stir well.
Stir in the Rolled oats and Cinnamon until a thick dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions and roll into balls.
Arrange balls on the prepared sheet, spacing 3 cm apart.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Keep refrigerated up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Salmon and Lentil Vegetable Patties
steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Finely grate Zucchini; squeeze firmly in a clean cloth to remove excess water.
Grate cooked Carrot and mince Garlic.
Flake cooked Salmon into a large bowl, removing any bones.
Add Cooked lentils, Egg, grated Zucchini, Carrot, Garlic, Fresh dill, and Lemon juice to the bowl.
Add Oat flour; stir until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Shape into 16 patties about 1.5 cm thick; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush patties lightly with Olive oil.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 2 months.

name: Banana Oat Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mash two ripe bananas in a large bowl until completely smooth.
Add the Unsweetened applesauce, Cinnamon, and Vanilla extract to the bowl.
Stir in the Rolled oats until a thick, cohesive dough forms.
Fold the Blueberries gently into the dough without crushing them.
Scoop tablespoon-sized mounds onto the prepared baking sheet, 2 cm apart.
Flatten each mound slightly with the back of a damp spoon.
Bake 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centres feel set.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack.
Makes 18 bites. Store in an airtight container: 3 days at room temperature or 1 month frozen.

name: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel the Sweet potato, cube it, and steam until fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
Mash the cooked Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth.
Drain and rinse the Cooked chickpeas, then add them to the bowl.
Mash the Cooked chickpeas coarsely, leaving some texture in the mixture.
Add the Chickpea flour, Ground cumin, Turmeric, and Lemon juice; stir to combine.
Divide the mixture into 12 equal balls and flatten each into a 1 cm patty.
Place the patties on the sheet and brush the tops lightly with Olive oil.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once halfway, until firm and golden on both sides.
Makes 12 patties. Store refrigerated for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Salmon and Lentil Patties with Zucchini
steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Combine Ground flaxseed and Water in a small bowl; rest 5 minutes to gel.
Grate Zucchini coarsely, then squeeze firmly in a clean towel to remove excess water.
Flake Salmon into a large bowl, removing any bones.
Add Cooked lentils, Zucchini, Gluten-free breadcrumbs, minced Garlic, Fresh dill, Lemon juice, and Salt.
Add the flaxseed gel and mix until the mixture holds together when pressed.
Shape into 12 patties, each about 1.5 cm thick, and arrange on the prepared baking sheet.
Brush patties lightly with Olive oil on top.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden on top and cooked through.
Cool 5 minutes before serving; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato and Broccoli
steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cut Sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; cut Broccoli into small florets.
Toss Sweet potato and Broccoli with 20 ml Olive oil and Salt on the baking sheet.
Roast vegetables 15 minutes, until Sweet potato begins to soften.
Mince Garlic; whisk with Lemon juice, Dijon mustard, remaining Olive oil, Paprika, and Dill.
Place Salmon portions on the baking sheet alongside the vegetables.
Brush Salmon evenly with the mustard-dill mixture.
Return baking sheet to oven for 12 to 14 minutes, until Salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Check that Sweet potato and Broccoli are golden and tender.
Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container up to 2 days.

name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube Sweet potato, then steam for 10 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the steamed Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth.
Mince the Garlic clove finely.
Add Cooked lentils, Egg, Oat flour, Ground cumin, Turmeric, and minced Garlic to the bowl.
Stir the mixture until fully combined and shapeable.
Shape the mixture into 16 patties, each about 1.5 cm thick.
Brush each patty lightly with Olive oil and place on the prepared sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until firm and golden on the outside.
Cool 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days, or freeze up to 2 months.

name: Sunflower Banana Oat Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and mash 2 ripe bananas thoroughly in a large bowl.
Add sunflower seed butter and maple syrup to the bowl.
Stir in cinnamon and vanilla extract until combined.
Fold in rolled oats and raisins until a soft dough forms.
Drop tablespoon-sized mounds onto the prepared baking sheet.
Flatten each mound gently with the back of a spoon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes, until set and lightly golden on the edges.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Store in an airtight container up to 3 days, or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Banana & Oat Blender Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Add the Rolled oats to a blender and process for 20 seconds into a coarse flour.
Add the Mashed banana, Eggs, Canola oil, Unsweetened applesauce, and Vanilla extract.
Add the Baking powder and Cinnamon to the blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until smooth and well combined.
Divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups, filling each two-thirds full.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until risen and a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
Serve at room temperature. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Banana & Chickpea Yogurt Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and lightly grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Mash the banana thoroughly in a large bowl until no lumps remain.
Whisk the plain yogurt, canola oil, and vanilla extract into the mashed banana.
Add the chickpea flour, oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon to the bowl.
Stir gently until just combined; the batter will be thick.
Divide the batter evenly among the 12 cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
Serve slightly warm or at room temperature. Store in an airtight container for up to 2 days, or freeze individually for up to 1 month.

name: Cucumber & Ricotta Pita Rounds
steps: Slice each pita bread into 8 wedges using a sharp knife.
Slice the cucumber into thin rounds, about 3 mm thick.
Finely chop the fresh dill.
In a small bowl, stir together the ricotta, lemon juice, olive oil, and dill.
Spread a heaped teaspoon of the ricotta mixture onto each pita wedge.
Place one cucumber round on top of each spread wedge.
Arrange on a plate and serve immediately, or refrigerate up to 4 hours before serving.

name: Turkey and Rice Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Dice Zucchini and Red bell pepper into 2 cm cubes.
Toss diced vegetables with 15 ml Olive oil, Salt, and Sweet paprika on the baking sheet.
Roast vegetables 20 minutes, until tender and lightly caramelised at the edges.
Meanwhile, bring Brown rice and Water to a boil in a medium saucepan, then simmer covered 25 minutes, until water is absorbed.
Mince Garlic and sauté in remaining 15 ml Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add Ground turkey and cook 8 to 10 minutes, breaking it apart, until no pink remains.
Stir Ground cumin, Tamari sauce, and Lemon juice into the turkey and cook 1 minute, until combined.
Divide Brown rice among four bowls; top with roasted vegetables and turkey mixture.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container up to 3 days.

name: Sweet Potato & Chickpea Mini Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube sweet potato into 2 cm pieces.
Steam sweet potato 10 minutes, until completely tender when pierced.
Mash sweet potato and cooked chickpeas together in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Add egg, chickpea flour, cumin, and turmeric; stir to a firm dough.
Shape the dough into 16 small patties, about 4 cm wide and 1 cm thick.
Place patties on the lined baking sheet and brush tops with olive oil.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.

name: Blueberry Banana Chickpea Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk mashed banana, eggs, plain yogurt, canola oil, and vanilla in a large bowl.
Add chickpea flour and baking powder to the bowl.
Stir gently until just combined; do not overwork the batter.
Fold in blueberries with a spatula, distributing evenly.
Divide batter equally among the 12 muffin cups, filling each three-quarters full.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 2 days, or refrigerate for 5 days.

name: Blueberry Chickpea Flour Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk together the chickpea flour, baking powder, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mash two ripe bananas until smooth.
Add the eggs, canola oil, and vanilla extract to the mashed banana and whisk well.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold the blueberries gently into the batter.
Divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze individually for up to 1 month.

name: Mini Cheesy Sweet Potato Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin.
Peel and grate the sweet potato finely into a large bowl.
Grate the cheddar and set it aside.
Add the wheat flour, baking powder, and salt to the bowl with the sweet potato.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs, cow's milk, and canola oil together.
Pour the egg mixture into the flour bowl and stir until just combined.
Fold in three-quarters of the grated cheddar gently.
Divide the batter evenly among the 24 muffin cups and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake for 16 to 18 minutes, until golden on top and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin before unmoulding. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Banana Blueberry Oat Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine Rolled oats, Cinnamon, and Baking powder.
Add Mashed banana, Unsweetened applesauce, Maple syrup, Vanilla extract, and Canola oil.
Stir until a thick, uniform dough forms.
Gently fold in Blueberries without crushing them.
Scoop 18 rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheet.
Flatten each portion lightly with the back of a spoon.
Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centres are set.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack.
Makes 18 bites · 4 family portions. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Mini Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube Sweet potato, then microwave for 5 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the cooked Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth.
Add drained Cooked chickpeas and mash roughly, leaving some texture.
Stir in Chickpea flour, one minced Garlic clove, Ground cumin, Sweet paprika, Salt, and Lemon juice.
Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions and shape each into a flat round patty.
Arrange patties on the prepared baking sheet and brush the tops with Olive oil.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the edges are crisp and the tops are golden.
Cool for 3 minutes on the sheet before serving.
Makes 12 patties · 4 family portions. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Mini Sweet Potato and Oat Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and grease a 12-cup mini muffin tin.
Peel and grate the sweet potato; measure out 150 g of packed grated flesh.
In a large bowl, whisk together oat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs, maple syrup, canola oil, cow's milk, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients; stir until just combined.
Fold in the grated sweet potato evenly throughout the batter.
Spoon the batter into the muffin tin, filling each cup to the top.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Chickpea and Cucumber Yogurt Dip with Pita
steps: Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas thoroughly in a colander.
Peel and mince the garlic clove finely.
Halve and deseed the cucumber, then dice into small 0.5 cm cubes.
Add chickpeas, plain Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and cumin to a food processor.
Blend for about 60 seconds until the dip is smooth and creamy.
Transfer the dip to a medium bowl and stir in the diced cucumber and fresh dill.
Cut each pita bread into 6 small triangles suitable for toddler hands.
Serve the dip in the bowl alongside the pita triangles for dipping.
Store leftover dip covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; keep pita separate.

name: Banana & Chickpea Energy Balls
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry with a clean cloth.
Mash the chickpeas and mashed banana together in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Add the sunflower seed butter and maple syrup; stir to combine.
Stir in the rolled oats and cinnamon until a firm dough forms.
Refrigerate the dough for 10 minutes so it is easier to shape.
Scoop the dough into 16 equal portions and roll each into a ball.
Arrange the balls on a plate in a single layer.
Serve immediately or refrigerate. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.

name: Sweet Potato & Oat Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube the sweet potato into 3 cm pieces.
Steam the sweet potato for 12 minutes, until completely tender, then mash smooth.
Stir ground flaxseed into water in a small bowl; rest 5 minutes until gel forms.
Combine mashed sweet potato, rolled oats, chickpea flour, cinnamon, and flaxseed gel in a large bowl.
Shape the mixture into 16 round patties, about 1.5 cm thick each.
Brush each patty lightly with olive oil on both sides.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping once halfway, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes before serving. Store refrigerated up to 3 days, or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Banana & Chickpea Soft Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas, then mash them thoroughly with a fork until mostly smooth.
Add mashed banana, canola oil, vanilla extract, and cinnamon to the chickpeas; stir well.
Fold in oat flour and baking powder until a soft, uniform dough forms.
Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared sheet, spacing 3 cm apart.
Gently flatten each mound to about 2 cm thick with the back of a spoon.
Bake 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are set and the tops feel dry to the touch.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Store in an airtight container up to 3 days, or freeze up to 1 month.
